title: AGF Wang tile components
description: S169 ENGINE-WANG-AUTOTILE primitive. Generic neighbour-aware tile-variant resolver (`engine/render/autotile/`). A 'tile family' (e.g. 'soft-block', 'hard-block', 'floor') ships 16 mesh variants — one per N/E/S/W edge bitmask of same-family neighbours; the resolver picks the matching variant for each cell. Schema captures the component shapes + the registered family/variant data shapes for runtime validation. WangTile cells coexist with project-specific family-membership components — projects either tag cells with the generic `WangTileFamilyMember` (familyName) or use their own gameplay markers and project-side predicates.

wangTileVariant.description: S169 — one mesh variant in a Wang tile family. Index 0..15 in `WangTileFamily.variants` matches the neighbour bitmask (bit3=N, bit2=E, bit1=S, bit0=W). `meshKey` is opaque to the engine — the project consumer looks it up in its own MeshHandleRegistry or procedural builder map.

meshKey.description: Opaque mesh identifier resolved by the consumer.

rotationY.description: Optional rotation about Y axis, in radians, applied by the consumer when spawning the variant mesh.

mirrorX.description: Optional X-axis mirror flag applied by the consumer when spawning the variant mesh.

wangTileFamily.description: S169 — full family registered at bootstrap. `variants` MUST contain exactly 16 entries; the array index is the neighbour bitmask. Duplicate entries (same meshKey across multiple bitmask indices) are allowed — different rotations of the same mesh is a common authoring pattern.

wangTileComponent.description: S169 — per-cell component placed on a tile entity. `familyName` selects the registered family; `currentVariantIndex` and `currentMeshKey` are runtime outputs written by `WangTileResolverSystem` and read by the project's mesh-spawn consumer. Engine writes; consumer reads.

currentVariantIndex.description: Resolver output: 0..15 index into the family's variants[]. Absent until the first resolve.

currentMeshKey.description: Resolver output: the resolved variant's meshKey. Convenience mirror so consumers don't need to re-index variants[].

currentMeshEntityId.description: Optional consumer-managed back-reference to the spawned variant mesh entity. The engine resolver does NOT write this in v1 (mesh entity spawn/dispose is a consumer concern); reserved so the schema covers the documented field name.

wangTileFamilyMemberComponent.description: S169 — generic family-membership tag. Place on the same entity as `WangTile` (or any cell-grid entity) to declare that the cell belongs to a Wang tile family. The resolver's default same-family predicate compares this component's `familyName`. Projects that prefer their own gameplay markers (e.g. `SoftBlock`, `HardBlock`) can supply a custom predicate to the resolver factory instead of writing this component.
